notes: On-farm RCBD trial, 50 farmers, Kasulu district, Tanzania, 2015-2016. Mucuna pruriens and Canavalia ensiformis grown as non-harvested green manure either intercropped (relay, sown two weeks after cassava) or as a sole crop in rotation before cassava; control = continuous sole cassava. Coded cover_crops. Economic results only in Table 5 (p9): TVC, net benefit and MRR per system. The mineral N treatment (Cassava + 50 kg N ha-1) is discussed in the text (p8-9) but has no row in Table 5, so no economic value for it. Not extracted: Table 2 'Cost saving (US$ ha-1)' = simulated urea replacement value of legume N (181.42, 141.96, 141.60, 99.32), which is not a World Bank outcome (it is a modelled input-substitution value). Pilot flag modelled_hint=True: the economic values are a partial budget on measured trial yields with assumed prices; coded field_measured, reviewer may prefer modelled. Farmer evaluation (p9) says acceptability of the rotation system was low, but gives no number.
